Noor: I'll update the project brief by Tuesday.
Lina: I'll check the budget by Thursday.

samples.title: Missing deadline
samples.notes:
Ari: I'll prepare the comparison.
Jo: We should explore a second design before deciding.
Team: We agreed to keep both options open.
Ari: The comparison needs feedback from two reviewers.

experiments.title: 1. Follow the evidence
experiments.goal: Run the notes, then select an action to highlight its source.

experiments.title: 2. Permit the cloud
experiments.goal: Disable the local candidate and permit cloud processing. Observe the permitted route.

experiments.title: 3. Work offline
experiments.goal: The network is unavailable. See why the local candidate can still be selected.

experiments.title: 4. Protect private notes
experiments.goal: No local candidate is available. Private notes must not escape to the cloud; execution is blocked.

experiments.title: 5. Give the meeting priority
experiments.goal: Start background indexing, then request a summary. Inspect the queue's decision.

experiments.title: 6. Recover from failure
experiments.goal: The first candidate times out. A cloud fallback is possible only with explicit permission.
